  4. Then result is released completely to CA.
 
Please confirm above is the scenario.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber, As per communication, I have explained that click on ‘Hide Comment’ is not considered as amending the result. Therefore, once the specimen no has been released from Result Entry and the test(PRELIM) is not required 2nd level validation, It will automatically appear at Clinician Access. If user decide to Hide the comment, user have to amend the result before Tick Hide Comment. Any amendment to the result will trigger the overwrite to Clinician Access. Kindly refer to attachment for sample simulation. As of now I will resolve this ticket. ​ Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber,

As per communication, I have explained that click on ‘Hide Comment’ is not considered as amending the result. 
Therefore, once the specimen no has been released from Result Entry and the test(PRELIM) is not required 2nd level validation,
It will automatically appear at Clinician Access.
 
If user decide to Hide the comment, user have to amend the result before Tick Hide Comment. Any amendment to the result will trigger the overwrite to Clinician Access.
 
Kindly refer to attachment for sample simulation.
As of now I will resolve this ticket.
​

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-ticket.description:
For example, I performed two updates for an existing record in Dispensing (manual): I unchecked Active in Dispensing → Edit Visit MT Subsidy Scheme Band. This updated VSSG from T to F. It then triggered an insertion into the audit table with the remark “Updated – Deactivated.” However, the VSSG_REMARKS remained as “Record Created – Jd” (as per #3 in the logic above). I believe this is where the confusion arises. For the same record, I then updated the Reason/Remarks field in Dispensing → Edit Visit MT Subsidy Scheme Band. The Active checkbox was unchanged (remained inactive). Since VSSG_REMARKS was not null, the existing remark “Record Created – Jd” was copied to the audit table (as per #1 in the logic above).
Currently, it appears that when a new scheme band record is added or an existing one is amended manually by a user, the VSSG_REMARKS field is not updated if amendment/insert manually in dispensing. I’ll clarify this part with the development team and provide you with an update.
The value found in VSSG for records created by users, the VSSG_REMARKS are either null or Updated - De-activated.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: SGH UAT issue # 50 - The Additional notes in the audit report that updated by users are not correct
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
For example, I performed two updates for an existing record in Dispensing (manual):
  1. I unchecked Active in Dispensing → Edit Visit MT Subsidy Scheme Band.
    • This updated VSSG from T to F.
    • It then triggered an insertion into the audit table with the remark “Updated – Deactivated.”
    • However, the VSSG_REMARKS remained as “Record Created – Jd” (as per #3 in the logic above).
    • I believe this is where the confusion arises.
  2. For the same record, I then updated the Reason/Remarks field in Dispensing → Edit Visit MT Subsidy Scheme Band.
    • The Active checkbox was unchanged (remained inactive).
    • Since VSSG_REMARKS was not null, the existing remark “Record Created – Jd” was copied to the audit table (as per #1 in the logic above).
Currently, it appears that when a new scheme band record is added or an existing one is amended manually by a user, the VSSG_REMARKS field is not updated if amendment/insert manually in dispensing.   I’ll clarify this part with the development team and provide you with an update.
 
The value found in VSSG for records created by users, the VSSG_REMARKS are either null or Updated - De-activated.

helpdesk-note.body: Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber, After multiple discussion, unfortunately the workaround was the permanent solution. Detailed Explanation: When a specimen from Histopathology, it may include one or more samples. According to our order entry requirements, sample details are mandatory, and users must at least enter details for Sample A. In the “Attach Image” function, the system displays the associated samples, and the results are considered specific to those samples. Therefore, when a user adds a new test under the same specimen number, the system continues to treat it as a Histopathology specimen, making sample information mandatory. If no samples are attached, the system treats the test as a normal test. As a result, it does not appear in the “Attach Image” function. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Regards, AdeaHub
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Muhammad Hafiz Bin Mat Zuber,

After multiple discussion, unfortunately the workaround was the permanent solution. 

Detailed Explanation:
When a specimen from Histopathology, it may include one or more samples. According to our order entry requirements, sample details are mandatory, and users must at least enter details for Sample A.
In the “Attach Image” function, the system displays the associated samples, and the results are considered specific to those samples.

Therefore, when a user adds a new test under the same specimen number, the system continues to treat it as a Histopathology specimen, making sample information mandatory.

If no samples are attached, the system treats the test as a normal test. As a result, it does not appear in the “Attach Image” function.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.  

Regards,
AdeaHub

helpdesk-note.body: From: Saravanan Ramamurthy <sramamurthy7@dedalus.com> Sent: Wednesday, August 13, 2025 6:35 PM To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com>; Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com> Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com> Subject: RE: MST0104689~CUST1194189- Minidump files generated from INQProcessorService-RXPRESS_INQ-SMXP_RXPRESS Hi Alex Please refer the attached email to migrate Inqueue service from Delphi 5 to Delphi 6 , working in windows 2019 machine to avoid mini dump file creation. From version 370 ,whenever we release any dll or INqueue services we release both Delphi 5 and Delphi6 version. Refer the release mail attached against 370 for Delphi 6 dll. But SKHOPASRDSDLL.dll missed in that release and not yet converted to Delphi 6 version. As part of 380 release, we make Delphi 6 version of SKHOPASRDSDLL.dll to avoid mini dump creation.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Saravanan Ramamurthy <sramamurthy7@dedalus.com>
Sent: Wednesday, August 13, 2025 6:35 PM
To: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com>; Nagarathinam Ramesh <nagarathinam.ramesh@dedalus.com>; IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com>
Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com>
Subject: RE: MST0104689~CUST1194189- Minidump files generated from INQProcessorService-RXPRESS_INQ-SMXP_RXPRESS

Hi Alex
 
Please refer the attached email to migrate Inqueue service from Delphi 5 to Delphi 6 , working in windows 2019 machine to avoid mini dump file creation.
 
From version 370 ,whenever we release any dll or INqueue services we release both Delphi 5 and Delphi6 version. Refer the release mail attached against 370 for Delphi 6 dll.
 
But SKHOPASRDSDLL.dll missed in that release and not yet converted to Delphi 6 version. As part of 380 release, we make Delphi 6 version of SKHOPASRDSDLL.dll to avoid mini dump creation.

helpdesk-ticket.description: Usually, the store can run the report cumulatively every month without any issues in version 5.x. However, in version 12.x, it cannot be run cumulatively, and users must split the report every 2 to 3 months. For example, if you need to report from January to September, you will have to split it into 3 or 4 parts. Attempting to run the report all at once (as simulate in 20241010-0737-09.6707085.mp4 ) will cause it to hang and result in an error (as attached in image.png).
helpdesk-ticket.subject: loading too long for transaction summary report.
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Usually, the store can run the report cumulatively every month without any issues in version 5.x.
However, in version 12.x, it cannot be run cumulatively, and users must split the report every 2 to 3 months.
For example, if you need to report from January to September, you will have to split it into 3 or 4 parts. Attempting to run the report all at once (as simulate in 20241010-0737-09.6707085.mp4 ) will cause it to hang and result in an error (as attached in image.png).

helpdesk-ticket.subject: Delay in ADT message processing
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
User is reporting that at certain peak hours (user noticed usually happening at 10am, 4pm) the ADT messages will take a longer time to process.
 
In this example it was created by user/sent out by OAS within 15:07
 
Maxcare received 15:07:47, processed 15:09:54
 
Can help to check for the reason why there is a delay in the processing of the ADT messages?

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Saravanan,
In tracer for OAS ADT msg processing, I found there is 1 system parameter 'SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT', it is setup as T at system level in SKH while SGH is setting it up as F, KKH does not have the setup.
Would like to know what is logic when this parameter is set to 'T' in SHSADTDLL.dll? I saw extra lines in the tracer in SKH UAT region after validating this parameter is T. To me, this parameter should be related smm dll ONLY.
This tracer is from SMXT, UAT region. [cid:image007.png@01DCA296.E376A570]
SKH Prod: [cid:image008.png@01DCA296.E376A570]
SGH prod: [cid:image009.png@01DCA296.E376A570] My thought is I do not think the clearing the A_VISIT_SUBSIDY_SCHEME_BAND table can speed up the processing speed for ADT msg. I checked SGH, when the A_VSSG is 128 million records or A_VSSG only has 100k records, the time taken to process an OAS ADT ranging from 1-3 sec in SGH. I do not see the difference.
Regards, Jade
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Saravanan,
 
In tracer for OAS ADT msg processing,  I found there is 1 system parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’, it is setup as T at system level in SKH while SGH is setting it up as F, KKH does not have the setup. 
 
Would like to know what is logic when this parameter is set to ‘T’ in SHSADTDLL.dll?  I saw extra lines in the tracer in SKH UAT region after validating this parameter is T.    To me, this parameter should be related smm dll ONLY.
 
This tracer is from SMXT, UAT region. 
 
SKH Prod:
 
SGH prod:
My thought is I do not think the clearing the A_VISIT_SUBSIDY_SCHEME_BAND table can speed up the processing speed for ADT msg.   I checked SGH, when the A_VSSG is 128 million records or A_VSSG only has 100k records, the time taken to process an OAS ADT ranging from 1-3 sec in SGH.  I do not see the difference.
 
 
 
Regards,
Jade

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Jade
This parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is available in the following dlls only and not available any other dlls and exes across maxcare and this parameter is introduced in the year of 2010 in all these dlls which is even before SKH and SKCH started using Maxcare.
SHSDATDLL.DLL, SHSIPADTDLL.DLL & all(DISPINTERFACE.DLL) - to execute the below query from these 3 dlls
UPDATE VISIT SET VIS_BILL_CATEGORY = :Bill_Cat WHERE VIS_PRN = :sPRN AND VIS_VISIT_NO = :Visit_No
SHSDATDLL.DLL - to execute the below query from this dll.
UPDATE VISIT SET VIS_ALTERNATE_VISIT_NUMBER=:ALTVISITNO,VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCP = DECODE(:HCP, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCP, DECODE(:HCP, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :HCP)), ' + 'VIS_PRINCIPAL_SPECIALTY = DECODE(:SPECIALTY, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_SPECIALTY, :SPECIALTY), ' + 'VIS_FINANCIAL_CLASS = DECODE(:FINCLASS, NULL, VIS_FINANCIAL_CLASS, :FINCLASS), ' + 'VIS_REFERRAL_SOURCE = DECODE(:REFERRALSOURCE, NULL, VIS_REFERRAL_SOURCE, DECODE(:REFERRALSOURCE, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :REFERRALSOURCE)), ' + 'VIS_VISIT_DATE = DECODE(:VISITDATE, TO_DATE(NULL), VIS_VISIT_DATE, :VISITDATE), ' + 'VIS_VISIT_TIME = DECODE(:VISITTIME, TO_DATE(NULL), VIS_VISIT_TIME, :VISITTIME), ' + 'VIS_PRINCIPAL_DEPARTMENT = DECODE(:DEPT, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_DEPARTMENT, :DEPT), ' + 'VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCO = DECODE(:HCO, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCO, DECODE(:HCO, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :HCO)), ' + 'VIS_PRINCIPAL_REASON_VISIT = DECODE(:REASONVISIT, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_REASON_VISIT, DECODE(:REASONVISIT, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :REASONVISIT)), ' + {$IFDEF SWI_LIB} 'VIS_BILL_CATEGORY = DECODE(:BILLCAT, NULL, VIS_BILL_CATEGORY, :BILLCAT), ' + 'VIS_EMPLOYMENT_ILLNESS = DECODE(:EMPLOYILLNESS, NULL, VIS_EMPLOYMENT_ILLNESS, :EMPLOYILLNESS), ' + 'VIS_TREATMENT_CATEGORY = DECODE(:TREATCAT, NULL, VIS_TREATMENT_CATEGORY, :TREATCAT), ' + {$ENDIF} 'VIS_MOD_DATE = :MODDATE, ' + 'VIS_MOD_USER = :MODUSER WHERE ' + 'VIS_ALTERNATE_VISIT_NUMBER = :TEMP_ALTVISITNO AND ' + 'VIS_PRN = :PRN';
To get Bill_Cat there is a procedure which is using following tables.
BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL ,BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP , BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY,BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST,VISIT_PAYER
Please check with SKH when this parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set as T and can if switch back to F, If they want T , then we need to check if proper indexes are being used in the above tables.
Saravanan Ramamurthy
IBA Pharmacy

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Saravanan,
Users may not be able to decide whether the parameter should be removed or set to 'F', especially since SKH inherited all the features built for SGH. They will likely ask about the purpose of this parameter.
I have located the Functional Specification (FS) that documents the logic of AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT. Please refer to Sections 3.6, 3.7, and 3.8 of the FS for detailed information. We need to verify whether SKH has any configurations set up for Patient Group Setup and Billing Category Status Setup.
* If such configurations exist, then logically the system parameter can be set to 'T'. * If no such configurations are available, enabling this parameter would serve no purpose.
Can you help to identify the tables related to Patient Group Setup and Billing Category Status Setup?
The following tables given your earlier email might be related to Billing Category Status Setup:
* BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL * BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP * BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY * BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST
Please let me know if there are any additional tables that should be included.
Regards, Jade

helpdesk-note.body:
Hi Jade, Good day. Based on my analysis, the sequence to obtain the bill category value is as follows: Step 1: PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings. Step 2: BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1). Step 3: When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe. This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
Nagarathinam Ramesh
IBA Pharmacy
m. +91 8270696776
e. nagarathinam.ramesh@adeahub.co<mailto:nagarathinam.ramesh@adeahub.co>

helpdesk-note.body-html:
Hi Jade,
Good day.
Based on my analysis, the sequence to obtain the bill category value is as follows:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.


 
 Nagarathinam Ramesh
 IBA Pharmacy

Users may not be able to decide whether the parameter should be removed or set to ‘F’, especially since SKH inherited all the features built for SGH. They will likely ask about the purpose of this parameter.
 
I have located the Functional Specification (FS) that documents the logic of AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT. Please refer to Sections 3.6, 3.7, and 3.8 of the FS for detailed information.
We need to verify whether SKH has any configurations set up for Patient Group Setup and Billing Category Status Setup.
  • If such configurations exist, then logically the system parameter can be set to ‘T’.

Please let me know if there are any additional tables that should be included.
 
Regards,
Jade

UPDATE VISIT SET VIS_BILL_CATEGORY = :Bill_Cat WHERE VIS_PRN = :sPRN AND VIS_VISIT_NO = :Visit_No

UPDATE VISIT SET VIS_ALTERNATE_VISIT_NUMBER=:ALTVISITNO,VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCP = DECODE(:HCP, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCP, DECODE(:HCP, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :HCP)), ' +

      'VIS_VISIT_DATE = DECODE(:VISITDATE, TO_DATE(NULL), VIS_VISIT_DATE, :VISITDATE), ' +
      'VIS_VISIT_TIME = DECODE(:VISITTIME, TO_DATE(NULL), VIS_VISIT_TIME, :VISITTIME), ' +
      'VIS_PRINCIPAL_DEPARTMENT = DECODE(:DEPT, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_DEPARTMENT, :DEPT), ' +
      'VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCO = DECODE(:HCO, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_HCO, DECODE(:HCO, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :HCO)), ' +
      'VIS_PRINCIPAL_REASON_VISIT = DECODE(:REASONVISIT, NULL, VIS_PRINCIPAL_REASON_VISIT, DECODE(:REASONVISIT, ' + #39 + NULLIFY_STRING + #39 + ' , NULL, :REASONVISIT)), ' +
{$IFDEF SWI_LIB}
    'VIS_BILL_CATEGORY = DECODE(:BILLCAT, NULL, VIS_BILL_CATEGORY, :BILLCAT), ' +
      'VIS_EMPLOYMENT_ILLNESS = DECODE(:EMPLOYILLNESS, NULL, VIS_EMPLOYMENT_ILLNESS, :EMPLOYILLNESS), ' +
      'VIS_TREATMENT_CATEGORY = DECODE(:TREATCAT, NULL, VIS_TREATMENT_CATEGORY, :TREATCAT), ' +
{$ENDIF}
    'VIS_MOD_DATE = :MODDATE, ' +
      'VIS_MOD_USER = :MODUSER WHERE ' +
      'VIS_ALTERNATE_VISIT_NUMBER = :TEMP_ALTVISITNO AND ' +
      'VIS_PRN = :PRN';
 
To get Bill_Cat there is a procedure which is using following tables. 
BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL ,BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP , BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY,BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST,VISIT_PAYER
 
Please check with SKH when this parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set as T  and can if switch back to F, If they want T , then we need to check if proper indexes are being used in the above tables.

Thanks for the details.
I have sent the recommendation to turn off the parameter after checking the data in SMXP.

[cid:image001.png@01DCA5BA.38CF92E0]

SELECT NUM_PERSON_NO, NUM_PERSON_ID, PTNT_PRN_NO_TYPE FROM PERSON_NO, PATIENT WHERE NUM_PERSON_NO = 'S7676767Z' AND PTNT_PERSON_ID(+) = NUM_PERSON_ID AND NUM_PERSON_NO_TYPE = 'PRN' ORDER BY PTNT_PRN_NO_TYPE [cid:image002.png@01DCA5BA.38CF92E0]
Please kindly advice.
Regards, Jade

Hi Jade,
Good day.
Based on my analysis, the sequence to obtain the bill category value is as follows:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
 
 
 
 Nagarathinam Ramesh

Can help to check for the reason why there is a delay in the processing of the ADT messages?

helpdesk-note.body: From: Jade Lau jlau32@adeahub.co Sent: Tuesday, February 24, 2026 5:03 PM To: Salma Banu salma.banu@adeahub.co; Mohamed Idrus Bin Mohamed Jamah (Synapxe) idrus.jamah@synapxe.sg; Prasangi Wimalasire (Synapxe) prasangi.wimalasire@synapxe.sg; Er Wei May (Synapxe) er.wei.may@synapxe.sg Cc: Rayar Dhana Sekaran (Synapxe) rayar.dhanasekaran@synapxe.sg; AdeaHub SG Helpdesk Team adeahub_sg_helpdeskteam@adeahub.co Subject: RE: Delay in ADT message processing - 985 HI Idrus, From the attached IBA tracer in SMXT for OAS ADT, we identified a system parameter being validated in OAS ADT program. This parameter is currently set to “T” in SKH, set to “F” in SGH, and not configured in KKH. We recommend turning off this parameter by setting it to “F”. After the change, we will monitor and assess whether system performance improves. Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘T’ in SMXP. Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘F’ in SMXP. We have checked the functionality of this parameter is to update the visit’s bill category of the visit if the parameter is set to ‘T’. The logic is as below: Step 1: PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings. Step 2: BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1). Step 3: When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VISIT.VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe. This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved. SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. This means for bill category ORGTRSUB is applicable/eligible for Inpatient Admitted visit for Patient group – ORGTRSUB( Organ Transplant Subsidy). The list of patient is configured in ‘Patient Group Setup’ Program. Screenshot taken from SMXT. SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP(SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. SELECT * FROM BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST (SMXP). Check in SMXT, same configuration is there. Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created. These patients configured in the Patient Group setup is not found in SMXP. Hence, turning off the parameter has no impact on this. Screenshot taken from SMXT. Regards, Jade

From: Jade Lau jlau32@adeahub.co 
 Sent: Tuesday, February 24, 2026 5:03 PM

 Subject: RE: Delay in ADT message processing - 985
 
HI Idrus,
 
From the attached IBA tracer in SMXT for OAS ADT, we identified a system parameter being validated in OAS ADT program. This parameter is currently set to “T” in SKH, set to “F” in SGH, and not configured in KKH.
 
We recommend turning off this parameter by setting it to “F”. After the change, we will monitor and assess whether system performance improves.
 
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘T’ in SMXP.
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘F’ in SMXP.
 
 
We have checked the functionality of this parameter is to update the visit’s bill category of the visit if the parameter is set to ‘T’. 
The logic is as below:
Step 1:
 PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
 BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
 When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VISIT.VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
 This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
 
 
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
This means for bill category ORGTRSUB is applicable/eligible for Inpatient Admitted visit for Patient group – ORGTRSUB( Organ Transplant Subsidy).
The list of patient is configured in ‘Patient Group Setup’ Program.
 
Screenshot taken from SMXT.
 
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP(SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
 
These patients configured in the Patient Group setup is not found in SMXP.  Hence, turning off the parameter has no impact on this.
 
Screenshot taken from SMXT.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Regards,
Jade

Hi Jade,
Good day.
Based on my analysis, the sequence to obtain the bill category value is as follows:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.

Subject: RE: Delay in ADT message processing - 985
 
Please be cautious.
Email is from outside of your organization.
Do not click on links or open files if unsure of sender.
 
HI Idrus,
 
From the attached IBA tracer in SMXT for OAS ADT, we identified a system parameter being validated in OAS ADT program. This parameter is currently set to “T” in SKH, set to “F” in SGH, and not configured in KKH.
 
We recommend turning off this parameter by setting it to “F”. After the change, we will monitor and assess whether system performance improves.
 
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘T’ in SMXP.
 
Parameter ‘SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT’ is set to ‘F’ in SMXP.
 
 
We have checked the functionality of this parameter is to update the visit’s bill category of the visit if the parameter is set to ‘T’.
The logic is as below:
Step 1:
PatientGroupSetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP and BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST tables to configure the patient group settings.
Step 2:
BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe references the BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY and BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL tables to configure the bill category at the visit level for patient/ patient group (configured in Step 1).
Step 3:
When the system parameter SMM_AUTO_UPD_BILLCAT is set to ‘T’, the system updates the VISIT.VIS_BILL_CATEGORY field based on the configuration defined in BillCatEligibilitySetup.exe.
This is standard system behaviour, and there is no client-specific code validation involved.
 
 
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIG_DETAIL (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_ELIGIBILITY (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
This means for bill category ORGTRSUB is applicable/eligible for Inpatient Admitted visit for Patient group – ORGTRSUB( Organ Transplant Subsidy).
The list of patient is configured in ‘Patient Group Setup’ Program.
 
Screenshot taken from SMXT.
 
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CAT_PATIENT_GROUP(SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
SELECT * FROM BILL_CATEGORY_PATIENT_LIST (SMXP).  Check in SMXT, same configuration is there.  Suspect these data are copied from SGH when DB was created.
 
 
These patients configured in the Patient Group setup is not found in SMXP.  Hence, turning off the parameter has no impact on this.
 
Screenshot taken from SMXT.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Regards,
Jade

helpdesk-ticket.description: In the Book Appointment and Fetch Cart APIs, THB is sending the data — ALOK_TEAM — as expected. However, the encounter is created in HIS against a practitioner with ID ‘ALOK’ which was disabled back in 2021, which shouldn’t have happened. We could see the consulting doctor by the name of ‘Dr Alok Mehra’(please refer to the attached bill). As we checked, we couldn’t find any practitioner by the name of ‘Dr. Alok Mehra’ in the Noida (MN) facility. However, we checked that Dr Alok Mehra exists in the DB with the Practitioner ID as ‘ALOK’ which has been disabled since 2021. Even in PR_ENCOUNTER, ATTEND_PRACTITIONER_ID is coming as ‘ALOK’. In fact, while booking the appointment on the caregiver, it was considered as ‘Dr Alok Thakar & Team’.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: GHL-SCF-3026: System picking wrong consultant while trying to register visit using fetch cart
helpdesk-ticket.description-html: In the Book Appointment and Fetch Cart APIs, THB is sending the data — ALOK_TEAM — as expected. However, the encounter is created in HIS against a practitioner with ID ‘ALOK’ which was disabled back in 2021, which shouldn’t have happened. We could see the consulting doctor by the name of ‘Dr Alok Mehra’(please refer to the attached bill). As we checked, we couldn’t find any practitioner by the name of ‘Dr. Alok Mehra’ in the Noida (MN) facility. However, we checked that Dr Alok Mehra exists in the DB with the Practitioner ID as ‘ALOK’ which has been disabled since 2021. Even in PR_ENCOUNTER, ATTEND_PRACTITIONER_ID is coming as ‘ALOK’. In fact, while booking the appointment on the caregiver, it was considered as ‘Dr Alok Thakar & Team’.

System does not allow user to save 2 dispensing restrictions with same restriction criteria (Visit / Last Dispense / Both) and same alert level (Reject / Query / Warning), but different in at least one of the following: (Where applicable for the restriction criteria) Visit Type, Duration Limit, Maximum Quantity, Reason Required, Password Required, Auto-Limit, Last Dispense Not Within
E.g. System does not allow the item to be set up have: 1 alert with Restriction Criteria = Visit, Alert level = Warning, nil setup for Visit Type, Duration Limit, Maximum Quantity 1 alert with Restriction Criteria = Visit, Alert level = Warning, Visit Type = External, nil setup forDuration Limit, Maximum Quantity (Intent is to show both alerts in the dispensing alert pop-up window if item is typed under Visit Type = External, and only the first alert if typed under other visit types)
Expected behaviour: Do not allow user to save 2 dispensing restrictions with identical criteria [Restriction Criteria, Alert Level, and (where applicable for the restriction criteria) Visit Type, Duration Limit, Maximum Quantity, Reason Required, Password Required, Auto-Limit, Last Dispense Not Within]. If any one of these criteria is different, allow to save (for scenarios where both restrictions apply, to apply the behaviour for both restrictions. Issue is recorded as below: Existing alert for Generic drug SMOFKABIVEN.

If any one of these criteria is different, allow to save (for scenarios where both restrictions apply, to apply the behaviour for both restrictions.

**08/10/2025 11:28:06 - Aini Shaella Binti Selamat (Customer Visible Notes) Hi @Dayang Sailam Binti Pg.Mulok, After analyzing the provided screenshot, we have concluded that the issue occurred due to the following scenarios: Scenario 1: 1) The item was prescribed and routed to the Pharmacy location. 2) The pharmacist verified the order.
**3) The nurse recorded the MAR before the pharmacist completed the dispensing process. During the MAR recording, the nurse selected a batch belonging to the Pharmacy location, which caused the stock to be deducted. Scenario 2: 1) The item was prescribed and routed to the Pharmacy location. 2) The pharmacist verified the order. 3) The pharmacist filled the order. 4) The nurse recorded the MAR before the pharmacist completed the dispensing process. During the MAR recording, the nurse selected a batch belonging to the Pharmacy location, which caused the stock to be deducted.
**Please note, the system has introduced a new parameter delivered through ML-MMOH-CRF-2178 (released in Sept 2024), which is currently available in the HSGB Testing environment. This parameter is controlled under PH Parameter for Facility > Batch ID Required Before Drug Administration. To prevent this issue from occurring, we recommend activating this parameter. This will make the Batch ID mandatory during MAR recording. Kindly refer to the attached DAF document for a better understanding.

helpdesk-ticket.description:

[SKH] – Tested and noted there are issue on this version as shown below. Issue: Value in Field “Current on Hand” not staying constant upon changing UOM in field “New Quantity”. By right it should stay the same. e.g., Item 0004-28-038-G, UOM conversion in Item Master
In Stock Adjustment,
Change the UOM from ‘TAB’ to ‘BOX’ in field “New Quantity”. Notice all fields’ UOM has changed to ‘BOX’ except those in greyed out status.
Change the UOM back to ‘TAB’ in field “New Quantity”. All fields’ UOM has changed to ‘BOX’ except those in greyed out status. Notice the value in field “Current on Hand” changed to ‘9000’, not ‘9486’.
If cursor is placed in “New Quantity” field and press ‘Tab’ key on keyboard, the value in ‘Change in Qty’ changed to ‘486’.
[Synapxe]: Saw in the UAF that this fix was for KKH, should this also be applied to SKH?
Thank you
Best Regards Prasangi Wimalasire Pharmacy Apps Ops

helpdesk-ticket.description: We occasionally receive complaints from medical or medical records staff that certain inpatients do not appear on their screens. Upon reviewing the database, we identified that the issue caused by incorrect values being stored in the patient_id or encounter_id in the table ip_open_encounter. To avoid delays in patient care and incomplete documentation, we correct the affected records manually as a temporary workaround. Attached you can find sample data from ip_episode and ip_open_encounter for an inpatient where we recently encountered this issue.

Attached you can find sample data from ip_episode and ip_open_encounter for an inpatient where we recently encountered this issue.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
We identified a case where a deceased patient record does not appear in the Inpatient Death Register report when a Nursing Unit Code is specified. However, when the report is executed without specifying the Nursing Unit Code, the deceased patient record appears, but the Patient Location field is empty. Technical Findings: Tracing the patient record in the PR_ENCOUNTER table shows that the value of PAT_CURR_LOCN_CODE is ‘KA01’. The code ‘KA01’ is not defined as a valid Nursing Unit in the system. Further review revealed that several other patient records also have the same invalid code assigned. Impact: This issue directly affects the accuracy of the Inpatient Death Register report, which is submitted to the Ministry of Health to report hospital deaths for a given period. Since the report is typically generated per Nursing Unit, deceased patients with this invalid location code are omitted, leading to incomplete and non-compliant reporting. Following are screenshots of the report parameters and output in both cases: Input:
Output:

Output:
helpdesk-ticket.subject: KAUH-SCF-0390 - Inpatient Death Register report
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
We identified a case where a deceased patient record does not appear in the Inpatient Death Register report when a Nursing Unit Code is specified. However, when the report is executed without specifying the Nursing Unit Code, the deceased patient record appears, but the Patient Location field is empty.
Technical Findings:
  • Tracing the patient record in the PR_ENCOUNTER table shows that the value of PAT_CURR_LOCN_CODE is ‘KA01’.
  • The code ‘KA01’ is not defined as a valid Nursing Unit in the system.
  • Further review revealed that several other patient records also have the same invalid code assigned.
Impact:
This issue directly affects the accuracy of the Inpatient Death Register report, which is submitted to the Ministry of Health to report hospital deaths for a given period. Since the report is typically generated per Nursing Unit, deceased patients with this invalid location code are omitted, leading to incomplete and non-compliant reporting.

**18/08/2025 08:55:51 - Jade Lau (Customer Visible Notes) For this log number # CUST1211665, we would like to do the fix for the store codes to be in sync between BLTX, TRDS and IHST. These are SMM orders, and the issued store is PHA2, and it is as expected. However, when doing the Return, TRDS and BLTX are taking the default store from the workstation which is PHA1, while IHST is taking original store which is PHA2. It should more flexible/logical to use default workstation store if the return of the drugs is meant to put back to the stock where return is performed. If the logic is to use the default workstation store, it means users need to change the default workstation store if they wish to put back the stock to original store. Alternatively, users need to go to the workstation where the default workstation store is the desired store. Please kindly check with user the preferred store to use.
**Please note that the Location (store) is not allowed to amend when doing the return. It is fetching values automatically from workstation setup. The testing performed in the workstation below and the Dispensing Default Store is being used (PHA1) This is the reported issue. Row #2 and #4 are return lines. It is having the store codes as PHA1 in TRDS and BLTX. The info is not in sync with IHST where the store code recorded here is PHA2, this is the info interfaced to WMS/SAP MM.

helpdesk-note.body: Reporting an issue with the Dispensing.exe program/file. Client Code: SKCH Program: Dispensing.exe Program version: 9.8.11.373 Issue Priority: Low Master Ticket #: MST0106100 Issue Summary When a user dispenses a SCM order for a drug, MaxCare applies the incorrect template instructions. Details The user expects MaxCare to use the template instructions associated with code ‘73’, but instead, it uses the template with code ‘024’. However, when the user manually dispenses the same drug, MaxCare correctly uses the ‘73’ template. This indicates an inconsistency between SCM order dispensing and manual dispensing processes. Expected Behavior MaxCare should consistently apply the correct template instructions (code ‘73’) regardless of whether the drug is dispensed via SCM order or manually. Findings on the Issue The instructions templates share the same sequence number (‘0’). No default template instructions assigned for the ‘SOL’ drug form. Cause of the Issue Please confirm if the root cause of this issue is due to different queries being used to retrieve the drug instruction template when dispensing via an SCM order versus manual dispensing. This discrepancy may be leading MaxCare to select the incorrect template (code ‘024’) during SCM dispensing, while correctly selecting template ‘73’ during manual dispensing. Replication Steps Please see the attached document.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
Reporting an issue with the Dispensing.exe program/file.
 
Client Code: SKCH
Program: Dispensing.exe
Program version: 9.8.11.373
Issue Priority: Low
Master Ticket #: MST0106100
 
Issue Summary
 When a user dispenses a SCM order for a drug, MaxCare applies the incorrect template instructions.
 
Details
  • The user expects MaxCare to use the template instructions associated with code ‘73’, but instead, it uses the template with code ‘024’.
  • However, when the user manually dispenses the same drug, MaxCare correctly uses the ‘73’ template.
  • This indicates an inconsistency between SCM order dispensing and manual dispensing processes.
 
Expected Behavior
 MaxCare should consistently apply the correct template instructions (code ‘73’) regardless of whether the drug is dispensed via SCM order or manually.
 
Findings on the Issue
  1. The instructions templates share the same sequence number (‘0’).
  1. No default template instructions assigned for the ‘SOL’ drug form.
 
Cause of the Issue
Please confirm if the root cause of this issue is due to different queries being used to retrieve the drug instruction template when dispensing via an SCM order versus manual dispensing.
This discrepancy may be leading MaxCare to select the incorrect template (code ‘024’) during SCM dispensing, while correctly selecting template ‘73’ during manual dispensing.
 
Replication Steps
Please see the attached document.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
NHCS reported that there are many cases occurred, where Maxcare responded the same sequence number to HealthHub. Upon checking, found that Maxcare is not returning the same sequence number from SCM. The sequence number that Maxcare returned is different from the sequence number from SCM.
Below is the example. The sequence number for Warfarin from SCM is 2, but the sequence number that Maxcare responded to HealthHub is 1 and 3. The sequence number for Simvastatin from SCM is 5, but the sequence number that Maxcare responded to HealthHub is 2.
Can help to check why Maxcare is responding to HealthHub with another sequence number that is different from the sequence number received from SCM? How can we reproduce the same scenario in Maxcare, for Maxcare to respond to HealthHub with the same sequence number for different order?

helpdesk-note.body: From: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com> Sent: Wednesday, July 23, 2025 5:05 PM To: IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com> Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com> Subject: RE: CUST1172840 - MedRefill : MaxCare's sequence number for Get Rx Details () Dear Sara & Naga Please advise the logic and which table column does MaxCare gets the SequenceNumber to be returned to HealthHub request (WS1 Type2). Steps to replicate: Send in the SCM order. Send the WS1 Type 2 request to the HealthHub web service and record the response. Intervene the 00O00005703R (Warfarin) drug with 2 new drugs. Intervene the 00O00005703U (Simvastatin) drug with 1 new drug. Cancel the 00O00005703Q drug in the order. Partial dispense the following drugs and finalize the encounter: `00O00005703T` (Carvedilol), `00O00005703R` (Warfarin) & `00O00005703U` (Simvastatin) The SequenceNumber for 00O00005703R (Warfarin) and 00O00005703U (Simvastatin) in the HealthHub response differs from the SequenceNumber generated by MaxCare. Please explain: how MaxCare generates the sequence number. which table and column are used to derive this value.
helpdesk-note.body-html:
From: Alex Yong <koonwin.yong@dedalus.com> 
 Sent: Wednesday, July 23, 2025 5:05 PM
 To: IBAPharmacy_DevInt <IBAPharmacy_DevInt@dedalus.com>
 Cc: Dedalus SG Helpdesk Team (HCS) <dedalus_sg_helpdeskteam@dedalus.com>
 Subject: RE: CUST1172840 - MedRefill : MaxCare's sequence number for Get Rx Details ()
 
Dear Sara & Naga
 
Please advise the logic and which table column does MaxCare gets the SequenceNumber to be returned to HealthHub request (WS1 Type2).
 
Steps to replicate:
  1. Send in the SCM order.
  1. Send the WS1 Type 2 request to the HealthHub web service and record the response.
  2. Intervene the 00O00005703R (Warfarin) drug with 2 new drugs.
  3. Intervene the 00O00005703U (Simvastatin) drug with 1 new drug.
  4. Cancel the 00O00005703Q drug in the order.
  5. Partial dispense the following drugs and finalize the encounter:
    1. `00O00005703T` (Carvedilol), 
    2. `00O00005703R` (Warfarin) & 
    3. `00O00005703U` (Simvastatin)
    4. The SequenceNumber for 00O00005703R (Warfarin) and 00O00005703U (Simvastatin) in the HealthHub response differs from the SequenceNumber generated by MaxCare. Please explain:
  1. how MaxCare generates the sequence number.
  2. which table and column are used to derive this value.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Hi Salma,
SKCH User reported the issue below: From my understanding, the red color in MaxCare Return module indicates either there is no qty or not enough qty to deduct for that particular line item. But rarely it will happen. For this item Nepro LP, we noted that there have been 2 cases with this same issue happening. Case details as follows: -
Background and findings When processing, we noted that the selected line item appears to be red in colour after moving it to the returns drug/ items section. To try it out, we ignored the colour and proceed to click finalized, the transaction looks like it went through sucessfully but when I went to check in maxcare item history, there is no line transaction reflecting that we have made the return in system. Hence, to process the actual return, I will need to select a different line item and return in system.
After looking into the patient medication history page in maxcare dispensing module, it’s true that there were no more quantity left to deduct as there was a returned made before.
Do let me know if any additional info is required. Please use this ticket number: IN1375240
Thank you

Hence, to process the actual return, I will need to select a different line item and return in system.
 
After looking into the patient medication history page in maxcare dispensing module, it’s true that there were no more quantity left to deduct as there was a returned made before.
 
 
Do let me know if any additional info is required.

0004ARIZ,  0004ARIY are records for message type ‘ADFTP03’
0004ARJ5, 0004ARJ6 are records for message type ‘SDFTP03’

PRN, item codes, and one of the date are missing.

PRN, Item codes are available.

Reported issues: 20 Sep 2024: User called around 3.30pm reported the stocktake document is not retrievable. At that time, the document STM0000003490 is at the 'Counting' status. User mentioned they hit access violation while using the program. Advice given to the user to exit all Stocktake program and DBA checking there is still 1 stocktake session recorded in the system. We had been checking the tables and couldn't retrieve the missing documents during the period. At around 5.30pm, Dedalus suggested user to re-create those missing documents. Missing document STM0000003491 to STM0000003516 did not appear. Below screenshots taken on 26 Sep 2024, those records did not appear still.
Reported case: 28 Jun 2024 User called around 5:03pm. He reported an issue where they are not able to retrieve the stocktake document after they posted it. According to the user, he created many stocktake documents for all bin but he can only retrieve 2. He was unable to search for the rest in the front-end program – Stocktake.exe. He can print Stocktake Posting Report on screen but there was no line in the document (blank page with preprinted info on it only ) user ignored it and continued to do stocktake posting for the rest of documents. At 5.16pm, when we queried the db, only 2 stocktake header were found:
At the time, we checked the document running number as well, the running number is STM0000003488. So, we were puzzled the missing documents from STM0000003445 till STM0000003488.
Called the user at 5:20pm, telling him only 2 stocktake documents found in the database. To advice him to raise the rest since we cannot find the rest. While talking to the user, he told me he was trying to post stocktake document STM0000003444 and it was hanging. He mentioned it was the second time he tried to post it. The first time, he ended the session first time when hanging happened. User called again at 5.35pm and updated that the document STM0000003444 posted successfully, and all the rest of the document appears.
We checked the database: At 5.36pm, when we retrieved the database again for the stocktake_header, there were 45 records found. Checked the add date/mod date, all the records are created before 5.16pm.
According to the user, SPACWF created all the stocktake documents in the same workstation. No usual thing he noticed. User EPATCL tried to post STM0000003444 because he found only 2 documents and STM0000003444 is at Counting status.

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Issue description : While processing SORM message with RXR|IV Intermittent , SCM InQ processor will first look for mapping in IE_Mapping , filed name: NCC_ROUTE_OF_ADMIN , If no record is found then SCM dll is searching in General Codes against TYPE=’ROA’ and JNRL_Description. In this case 'IVINTER' is mapped and stored in MaxCare tables. Subsequently 'IVINTER' stored in TRDS_ROUTE_OF_ADMIN and being send out in RDE RXR-1 which fails in SCM as IVINTER is an invalid ROA in SCM. In order to fix this issue, User wants to inactivate general code - IVINTER for type ROA , so that SCM dll retains original route - IV Intermittent in MaxCare tables. Existing SCM DLL is not checking for JNRL_ACTIVE =’T’ for type –‘ROA’ and inactive ROA code is also getting mapped. Kindly added additional filtering in the below query to check for JNRL_ACTIVE =’T’
SQLTracer log
General Codes
helpdesk-ticket.subject: NCC- RDE RXR-1 IE Mapping Issue
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Issue description :   While processing SORM message with RXR|IV Intermittent ,  SCM InQ processor will first look for mapping in IE_Mapping , filed name: NCC_ROUTE_OF_ADMIN , If no record is found then SCM dll is searching in General Codes against TYPE=’ROA’ and JNRL_Description. In this case 'IVINTER' is mapped and stored in MaxCare tables. Subsequently 'IVINTER' stored in TRDS_ROUTE_OF_ADMIN and being send out in RDE RXR-1 which fails in SCM as IVINTER is an invalid ROA in SCM.  In order to fix this issue,  User wants to inactivate general code - IVINTER for type  ROA , so that SCM  dll retains  original route - IV Intermittent in MaxCare tables.  Existing SCM DLL is not checking for JNRL_ACTIVE =’T’ for type –‘ROA’ and inactive ROA code is also getting mapped. Kindly added additional filtering in the below query to check for JNRL_ACTIVE =’T’
 
SQLTracer log
 
General Codes

helpdesk-ticket.subject: AAKH-CRF-0177- DOH requirement of adding the Enc type and end date to the generated XML

AAKH-CRF-0177- DOH requirement of adding the Enc type and end date to the generated XM
Based on the DOH requirement- and recent Tasneef audit , these XML tags to be added in the generated claims XML as per new regulations.
Currently only the Encounter Start date alone is present and the End date is not present in the generated xml thus to be added the end date and also the Start & End type as well.
For op claims end type will beÂ 1
Â 
Sample XML
Â 
<Encounter>
<FacilityID>MF2555</FacilityID>
<Type>3</Type>
<PatientID>1245</PatientID>
<Start>01/01/2010 12:00</Start>
<End>01/05/2010 15:00</End>
<StartType>1</StartType>
<EndType>1</EndType>
</Encounter>

helpdesk-ticket.description:
Existing process of drug creation is very complicated, involving UI, SQL scripts and direct database changes. So we need a more automated process for drug creation. Â For each new Drug creation requires navigation between the below screens: Item: Material base. Item: Inventory management. Item UOM definition. Trade name for item. Drug. Backend configuration: Local/ imported configuration. Drug price setup. IQVIA mapping. GTIN code configuration.
Â In addition to the prerequisites which may be needed: Trade name creation. Generic name creation. Drug form. Drug UOM. Equivalent UOM.
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MOHE-CRF-0189- MOH Egypt drug catalogue
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Existing process of drug creation is very complicated, involving UI, SQL scripts and direct database changes.
So we need a more automated process for drug creation.
Â 
For each new Drug creation requires navigation between the below screens:
  1. Item: Material base.
  2. Item: Inventory management.
  3. Item UOM definition.
  4. Trade name for item.
  5. Drug.
  6. Backend configuration:
    1. Local/ imported configuration.
    2. Drug price setup.
    3. IQVIA mapping.
    4. GTIN code configuration.
Â 
In addition to the prerequisites which may be needed:
  1. Trade name creation.
  2. Generic name creation.
  3. Drug form.
  4. Drug UOM.
Equivalent UOM.

helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Currently only the final diagnosis code is getting stored in EM and sub-codes are not getting stored anywhere in EM, would need discussion with EM team where all the selected sub-codes by the doctor can be stored in EM.
in ICD11 tool, diagnosis final code results from the composition of sub-codes of 2 levels:
stem diagnosis codes
extension codes
in EM currently the final diagnosis code is stored and displayed as a single level
Required changes:
  • EM to store and display the ICD11 sub-codes for each diagnosis level selected

The order associated packages have a special behaviour which couldn't be applied on all OP packages, and in normal OP visits the user should be able to select the package linked to the encounter instead of registering the visit separately and go to make another additional step from the package subscription screen. The same behaviour already happens in the IP packages, the user can select any package in the admit patient screen since it's flagged with IP package type without any other restrictions and additional steps.

helpdesk-ticket.subject: MOHE-CRF-0175: Allergy onset time in OHC Message
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
When we receive new ADT A08 outbound message for Allergy onset time value in segment (AL1)
Â 
Allergy onset time: get the date and time of wrong column from EM Database
Table (PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION) Column (ADDED_DATE)
Â 
Current query format:
Â 
SELECT 'AL1'#ROWNUM#B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE#A.ALLERGEN_CODE||'^'||(CASE WHEN B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE = 'DA' THEN (SELECT GENERIC_NAME FROM PH_GENERIC_NAME WHERE GENERIC_ID=A.ALLERGEN_CODE) ELSE (SELECT LONG_DESC FROM MR_ALLERGEN WHERE ALLERGEN_CODE=A.ALLERGEN_CODE) END)#
DECODE(SEVERITY,'M','MI^MILD','O','MO^MODERATE','S','SV^SEVERE','UN^UNKNOWN')#A.ADV_REAC_CODE||'^'||(SELECT LONG_DESC FROM AM_REACTION WHERE REACTION_CODE=A.ADV_REAC_CODE)#
TO_CHAR(A.ADDED_DATE,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')
FROM PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION A, MR_ADV_EVENT_TYPE B
WHERE A.ADV_EVENT_TYPE = B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE AND A.STATUS='A' AND
A.PATIENT_ID=:OBS[7]
UNION ALL SELECT 'AL1'#ROWNUM#NULL#NULL||'^'||'No Known Allergies'#NULL#NULL#TO_CHAR(A.MODIFIED_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') FROMÂ Â Â  MP_PATIENT A WHEREÂ Â Â  A.PATIENT_ID = :OBS[7] ANDÂ Â Â  A.KNOWN_ALLERGY_YN = 'N'
and A.PATIENT_ID not in (SELECT AE.PATIENT_ID FROM PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION AE WHERE AE.STATUS='A')
Â 
Current message format:
Â 
MSH|^~\&|DXCEM|A2|OHCAPPL|A2|20230704091303||ADT^A08|1208396|P|2.4|||NE||
PID|||A200000657||Vash3^Rahul^||20000202000000|M||DOT^DOT||||||S^Single|H^HINDU|A200000657|78657476464746||||IN^India|||EGP^EGYPTIAN||EGP||N
AL1|1|DA|12593^Meningitidis Group W135 Polysaccharide|SV^SEVERE|02^EDEMA|20220316082202
AL1|2|DA|13291^Manganese (II)-Chloride-Tetrahydrate|MO^MODERATE|03^RASH|20220316081459
AL1|3|DA|13291^Manganese (II)-Chloride-Tetrahydrate|MO^MODERATE|04^FEVER|20220316081459
AL1|4|FA|F039^Skipjack Tuna / Longtail Tuna|MI^MILD|01^HIVES|20230704090424
AL1|5|FA|F039^Skipjack Tuna / Longtail Tuna|MI^MILD|02^EDEMA|20230704090424
AL1|6|FA|F062^Catfish|MO^MODERATE|02^EDEMA|20230704091244
AL1|7|GE|X051^BANANA, PINAPPLE, AVOCARDO|MI^MILD|07^Stridor|20220316082726
Â 
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Â 
We need to change the query of ADT A08 outbound message for Allergy onset time value in segment (AL1)
Â 
Allergy onset time: Should get the date of column from EM Database
Table (PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION) Column (REACTION_DATE)
Because this column already calculating the correct allergy onset date according to practitioner selection.
Â 
New query format:
SELECT 'AL1'#ROWNUM#B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE#A.ALLERGEN_CODE||'^'||(CASE WHEN B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE = 'DA' THEN (SELECT GENERIC_NAME FROM PH_GENERIC_NAME WHERE GENERIC_ID=A.ALLERGEN_CODE) ELSE (SELECT LONG_DESC FROM MR_ALLERGEN WHERE ALLERGEN_CODE=A.ALLERGEN_CODE) END)#
DECODE(SEVERITY,'M','MI^MILD','O','MO^MODERATE','S','SV^SEVERE','UN^UNKNOWN')#A.ADV_REAC_CODE||'^'||(SELECT LONG_DESC FROM AM_REACTION WHERE REACTION_CODE=A.ADV_REAC_CODE)#
TO_CHAR(A.REACTION_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')
FROM PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION A, MR_ADV_EVENT_TYPE B
WHERE A.ADV_EVENT_TYPE = B.ADV_EVENT_TYPE_CODE AND A.STATUS='A' AND
A.PATIENT_ID=:OBS[7]
UNION ALL SELECT 'AL1'#ROWNUM#NULL#NULL||'^'||'No Known Allergies'#NULL#NULL#TO_CHAR(A.MODIFIED_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') FROMÂ Â Â  MP_PATIENT A WHEREÂ Â Â  A.PATIENT_ID = :OBS[7] ANDÂ Â Â  A.KNOWN_ALLERGY_YN = 'N'
and A.PATIENT_ID not in (SELECT AE.PATIENT_ID FROM PR_ADVERSE_EVENT_REACTION AE WHERE AE.STATUS='A')
Â 
New message format:
MSH|^~\&|DXCEM|A2|OHCAPPL|A2|20230926144804||ADT^A08|1240154|P|2.4|||AL||
PID|||A200000657||Vash3^Rahul^||20000202000000|M||DOT^DOT||||||S^Single|H^HINDU|A200000657|78657476464746||||IN^India|||EGP^EGYPTIAN||EGP||N

helpdesk-ticket.description:
As per GAHC business requirements, we need to enable HL7 messages to be able to handle the standardized panic values and panic high or low reference ranges. Â HL7 Standard Tables:
VALUE
DESCRIPTION
<Â
Below absolute low-off instrument scale
>Â
Above absolute high-off instrument scale
A
Abnormal (applies to non-numeric results)
AA
Very abnormal (applies to non-numeric units, analogous to panic limits for numeric units)
B
Better--use when direction not relevant
D
Significant change down
H
Above high normal
HH
Above upper panic limits
I
Intermediate. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.
L
Below low normal
LL
Below lower panic limits
MS
Moderately susceptible. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.
N
Normal (applies to non-numeric results)
null
No range is defined, or normal ranges don't apply
R
Resistant. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.
S
Susceptible. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.
U
Significant change up
VS
Very susceptible. Indicates for microbiology susceptibilities only.
W
Worse--use when the direction is not relevant
Â Â Â So, we can be able to receive the ORU messages as below: Message example: MSH|^~\&|LDM|LDM|DXCEM|U5|20240511010954||ORU^R01|67286023|P|2.3 PID|1||U500100550||^Ø§Ø¨Ù†Â Â Ø§Ø³Ù…Ø§Ø¡ Ø§Ø´Ø±Ù

helpdesk-note.body: To create Growth Chart Configuration 1. Create Graph in Chart Setup 2. Configure the Graph Applicability 3. Add Discrete Measure in the Chart Component 4. Then create Special Chart Graph to map X-axis against Y-axis 5. Enable the the applicable chart group in Special Chart Groups Data upload shall be done for table: 1. CA_SPL_CHART_REF_DTL 2. CA_SPL_CHART_REF_VALUE 3. CA_SPL_CHART_KEY_VALUE For growth chart, it is easier to involve the data upload activity as the value entry is too large in number
helpdesk-note.body-html:
To create Growth Chart

Configuration
1. Create Graph in Chart Setup
2.  Configure the Graph Applicability
3. Add Discrete Measure in the Chart Component
4. Then create Special Chart Graph to map X-axis against Y-axis
5. Enable the the applicable chart group in Special Chart Groups

Data upload shall be done for table:
1. CA_SPL_CHART_REF_DTL
2. CA_SPL_CHART_REF_VALUE
3. CA_SPL_CHART_KEY_VALUE


For growth chart, it is easier to involve the data upload activity as the value entry is too large in number

helpdesk-ticket.description: Hi Team Need some advice/solution for this issue.Â User need to hold item after delivery has been done. When using re route function the requested prescription is not appear.Â Checking has been done and find one of the item in the prescription has been HOLD.Â Has been advice before by your team that once one item in the prescription has been HOLD the prescription cannot be routed to other location until the item being released (unhold). In this case what is the best solution for user to hold the requested item.Â Please find attachment for some screen shots. ThanksÂ Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Unable to find prescription. SD01465614
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:

User need to hold item after delivery has been done.
When using re route function the requested prescription is not appear.Â 
Checking has been done and find one of the item in the prescription has been HOLD.Â 
Has been advice before by your team that once one item in the prescription has been HOLD the prescription cannot be routed to other location until the item being released (unhold).
In this case what is the best solution for user to hold the requested item.Â 
Please find attachment for some screen shots.
ThanksÂ Â

helpdesk-ticket.description: Kindly advise on the user's email below. Â Dear ICT team,Â We would like to request a modification to the interface used in HIS and medavis RIS to order X-rays. Currently, the interface does not clearly specify the required order details (only has 1 column for clinical comment), which can lead to inadequacy of information and misdiagnosis. We would appreciate it if it could be divided and specified into three columns (Indication, Clinical history, Localisation). All columns should be compulsory to be filled in in order to proceed with the x-ray request through HIS. Once the X-ray request has been placed, the completely filled-in columns should also appear in Medavis RIS to ensure complete and accurate clinical information is available. We have attached an example of the interface that we would like to have for your reference (medavis RIS interface). Please let us know if you need any further details from our side. We would also appreciate it if we could arrange a meeting to discuss this request further at your convenience. Best regards, Dr Aimi Asyura Binti Mohd Zuhudi Medical Officer Radiology Department Hospital Tunku Azizah
helpdesk-ticket.subject: Modification to the interface used in HIS and Medavis RIS to order X-rays
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
Kindly advise on the user's email below.
Â 
Dear ICT team,Â 

We would like to request a modification to the interface used in HIS and medavis RIS to order X-rays.
Currently, the interface does not clearly specify the required order details (only has 1 column for clinical comment), which can lead to inadequacy of information and misdiagnosis.

We would appreciate it if it could be divided and specified into three columns (Indication, Clinical history, Localisation).
All columns should be compulsory to be filled in in order to proceed with the x-ray request through HIS.
Once the X-ray request has been placed, the completely filled-in columns should also appear in Medavis RIS to ensure complete and accurate clinical information is available.

We have attached an example of the interface that we would like to have for your reference (medavis RIS interface).

Please let us know if you need any further details from our side. We would also appreciate it if we could arrange a meeting to discuss this request further at your convenience.
Best regards,
Dr Aimi Asyura Binti Mohd Zuhudi
Medical Officer
Radiology Department
Hospital Tunku Azizah

helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-CRF-20231 - 2nd level reviewer does not appear as Reporting practitioner or verified by Laboratory results released by lab physicians are reflected in the clinician's access with Reporting practitioner(in the result) and verified by (in clinical event) Â . Â Incase the result is released from 2nd level review, the reporting practitioner (in the result) Â and verified by (in clinical event) Â Â respectively shows the user releasing the result from 1st level review. so if the consultant released the result from 2nd level review, in the clinician access, the system will show the practitioner releasing the results (usually the chemist) who released it from the 1st level review, which itâ€™s not the case Â The reporting practitioner (in the result) and verified by (in clinical event) should reflect the final releasing practitioner if the case is released from the 2nd level review Â N.B if the specimen is finally released from the by specimen or 1st level review functions it works as expected Â
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MO-CRF-20231 - 2nd level reviewer does not appear as Reporting practitioner or verified by
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
MO-CRF-20231 - 2nd level reviewer does not appear as Reporting practitioner or verified by
Laboratory results released by lab physicians are reflected in the clinician's access with Reporting practitioner(in the result) and verified by (in clinical event) Â .
Â 
Incase the result is released from 2nd level review, the reporting practitioner (in the result) Â and verified by (in clinical event) Â Â respectively shows the user releasing the result from 1st level review.

so if the consultant released the result from 2nd level review, in the clinician access, the system will show the practitioner releasing the results (usually the chemist) who released it from the 1st level review, which itâ€™s not the case
Â 
The reporting practitioner (in the result) and verified by (in clinical event) should reflect the final releasing practitioner if the case is released from the 2nd level review
Â 
N.B if the specimen is finally released from the by specimen or 1st level review functions it works as expected
Â

helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-MCMSS-CRF-0021 Cardiology Integration Scenario: In Emergency department, Nurses performing ECG without orders, Patient ID / Name is recorded in the 3rd party application during ECG investigations. soft copy of the ECG report is stored in in shared path automatically by the 3rd party application. Requirement is to view these ECG Results from HIS (Patient chart), i.e. In EM HIS patient chart some link to be provided, upon clicking link, EM-HIS to open ECG report for the patient. For In inpatients:, Doctors will create ECG Order request from EM HIS and based on the request ECG investigations will be performed by the Nurses. The device performs ECG, echo & Stress Test (TMT) & it will post a PDF report in a shared folder for those results
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MO-MCMSS-CRF-0021 Cardiology Integration
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
MO-MCMSS-CRF-0021 Cardiology Integration
Scenario:
  • In Emergency department, Nurses performing ECG without orders, Patient ID / Name is recorded in the 3rd party application during ECG investigations.
  • soft copy of the ECG report is stored in in shared path automatically by the 3rd party application.
  • Requirement is to view these ECG Results from HIS (Patient chart), i.e. In EM HIS patient chart some link to be provided, upon clicking link, EM-HIS to open ECG report for the patient.
  • For In inpatients:, Doctors will create ECG Order request from EM HIS and based on the request ECG investigations will be performed by the Nurses.
The device performs ECG, echo & Stress Test (TMT) & it will post a PDF report in a shared folder for those results

helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-CRF-20229 - Radiology (GE-PACS) Integration with EM The RIS/PACS integration for GE-PACS shall utilize HL7 communication protocols to ensure interoperability between the EM HIS and the external PACS/VNA systems. The same set of standard HL7 touchpoints already implemented in the MEA region for GE PACS will be replicated. Interface will be from EM HIS to the external VNA Broker (bi-directional, HL7-based). PACS Broker (required for image linking/viewing) must be provided by the customer. Optionally, PACS can be proposed separately to MCMSS Quram, based on commercial acceptance. ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer) messages to be sent outbound from EM HIS. Radiology Orders: To be transmitted outbound from EM HIS to PACS. Radiology Results: Entered in GE PACS and transmitted back inbound to EM HIS. Image Viewing: Clinicians in EM HIS can access radiology images via the PACS Broker using a link shared by GE PACS. â€˜ADT^A04â€™ Register Patient â€˜ADT^A08â€™ Patient Update â€˜ADT^A40â€™ Patient Merge â€˜ORM^O01â€™ Physician Order â€˜ORU^R01â€™ Radiology Result and report
helpdesk-ticket.subject: MO-CRF-20229 - Radiology (GE-PACS) Integration with EM
helpdesk-ticket.description-html:
MO-CRF-20229 - Radiology (GE-PACS) Integration with EM
The RIS/PACS integration for GE-PACS shall utilize HL7 communication protocols to ensure interoperability between the EM HIS and the external PACS/VNA systems. The same set of standard HL7 touchpoints already implemented in the MEA region for GE PACS will be replicated.
  • Interface will be from EM HIS to the external VNA Broker (bi-directional, HL7-based).
  • PACS Broker (required for image linking/viewing) must be provided by the customer.
  • Optionally, PACS can be proposed separately to MCMSS Quram, based on commercial acceptance.
  • ADT (Admission, Discharge, Transfer) messages to be sent outbound from EM HIS.
  • Radiology Orders: To be transmitted outbound from EM HIS to PACS.
  • Radiology Results: Entered in GE PACS and transmitted back inbound to EM HIS.
  • Image Viewing: Clinicians in EM HIS can access radiology images via the PACS Broker using a link shared by GE PACS.
â€˜ADT^A04â€™ Register Patient
â€˜ADT^A08â€™ Patient Update
â€˜ADT^A40â€™ Patient Merge
â€˜ORM^O01â€™ Physician Order
â€˜ORU^R01â€™ Radiology Result and report

helpdesk-ticket.description: MO-MCMSS-CRF-0016 - Â LIS Auto release function including Age & Gender Currently, results received from the Analyzer are loaded into LIS (Medicom) result Entry By Specimen function (using LIS interface/drivers), and then Lab Technicians release the results manually after reviewing the results one by one. The new requirement is that all results should be released automatically upon receiving them from the Analyzers and stay in the First/Second Level Review if the results are abnormal.
